_README: Line-source research log for the matches Hotspawn lists but the four primary feeds do not price.
Every row records what was actually requested from a GitHub Actions runner (the build sandbox has no
outbound HTTPS), what came back, and why the source is or is not used. Evidence files are committed,
so a reader can re-check a verdict instead of trusting a sentence.
Nothing here is an inferred price. A source is only usable if it returns a real decimal quote for a
specific fixture that can be matched to a Hotspawn match id.
runner: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest, python urllib, honest User-Agent

rows.name: bo3.gg API
rows.purpose: esports match centre reported to relay bookmaker quotes
rows.result: HTTP 200 JSON (82,464 matches), but every discipline filter shape is ignored (identical count and identical first row for filter[disciplines][eq]=3, filter[discipline_id]=3, discipline_id=3, filter[game]=lol); /match_odds, /odds and /bets return 404; match detail by id 404.
rows.verdict: not usable as a price source

rows.name: Kambi / Unibet offering API
rows.result: HTTP 400 {"error": {"message": "Unable to resolve customer for extApiEndpoint ubus"}} with full lang/market/client_id/channel_id params; group.json same.
rows.verdict: not usable - endpoint needs a customer id this project does not have

rows.name: Betfair Exchange public API
rows.result: DNS resolution failed from the runner (Name or service not known).

rows.name: Betano
rows.result: HTTP 200 but an HTML application shell (29,481 bytes), not JSON; no price payload.
rows.verdict: not usable without a browser-rendered session

rows.name: EGamersWorld
rows.purpose: odds aggregator, widest published LoL coupon
rows.result: HTTP 403 Cloudflare from the runner; readable from a browser session. Manual receipts captured 2026-10-23 are corroboration only: 9 usable quotes (bo3.gg + EGamersWorld) agree with our published lines, maximum gap 2.8 pp.

rows.name: OddsPortal
rows.result: HTTP 200 but JavaScript-rendered; the HTML contains no prices. Its LoL section lists a single competition, the World Championship (recorded in coverage.html and the session audit).

rows.name: BC.GAME / Rivalry
rows.purpose: crypto esportsbooks that sometimes carry regional LoL
rows.result: HTTP 200 HTML shells; no public JSON endpoint identified for their LoL coupon.
rows.verdict: not usable without reverse-engineering a private API

rows.name: Pinnacle guest API
rows.result: HTTP 200. Measured on a runner snapshot of 352 esports matchups, the only League of Legends competition listed was the World Championship among 16 leagues (mostly CS2, Dota 2 and Valorant); see coverage.html for the same measurement.
rows.verdict: used where it prices; silent below tier 1

rows.name: Polymarket / Kalshi / Bovada
rows.purpose: prediction markets and a US esportsbook
rows.result: HTTP 200; each prices only the tier-1 series it lists (Worlds, LCP Promotion, LGC Rising).
rows.verdict: used where they price; no regional coverage

rows.name: OddsPortal LoL index (re-read 2026-10-24)
rows.purpose: confirm whether any national/academy LoL coupon appeared after Worlds Swiss day 2
rows.result: HTTP 200. The LoL index still lists exactly one competition: 'League of Legends World Championship (11)'. No PRM, RIVALS, Tunisian Super League, Arabian League, Komplettligaen or other Hotspawn national division is present.
rows.verdict: coverage evidence only — structural ceiling unchanged; regional matches stay on originated Elo

rows.name: Unibet/Kambi ubse LoL JSON (re-read 2026-10-24)
rows.purpose: live regulated sportsbook moneylines for matches Hotspawn lists
rows.result: HTTP 200 JSON. Open Match Odds for Worlds 2026 Swiss only (TOP Esports vs Anyone's Legend, CTBC Flying Oyster vs Movistar KOI, G2 Esports vs LØS, Lyon Gaming vs Karmine Corp, Invictus Gaming vs Team Secret Whales, plus later Swiss ties). No national-division events in the feed.
rows.verdict: used as the Unibet venue in the market consensus where team names join a Hotspawn fixture; no regional coverage

rows.name: 51-venue low-tier probe (2026-10-24, session e32a5c4b)
rows.purpose: does ANY established book / esportsbook / exchange / aggregator list the 27 non-featured Hotspawn competitions?
rows.result: HTTP 200 Hotspawn inventory (241 fixtures, 29 competitions). Only Worlds (5 venues) and LGC Rising (Polymarket) matched. 17x200 (mostly HTML shells with zero tail fixtures), 18x403, 6x404, 2x429 Kambi alt-operators. 888sport/Rivalry word hits are generic-word false positives; Pinnacle lists a PRM team name but prices no PRM series moneyline.
rows.verdict: no usable low-tier line anywhere reachable; originated/provisional/settlement fallback is the only honest resolution

rows.name: Hotspawn Pick'ems rules (official)
rows.purpose: pick lock time + forfeited/cancelled match settlement
rows.result: Picks lock 5 minutes before scheduled start. Forfeited match: all predictions voided, no points awarded or deducted. Cancelled match: predictions cancelled, no points.
rows.verdict: official settlement authority for the 4 Solid Gaming cards: expected VOID; settlement pick shown is conditional on walkover grading
rows.evidence: fetched live 2026-10-24; cited on index.html + unresolved.html
